title: Wed 11 Nov 2026: Toward the idea-to-deploy factory
description: Oliver and Sophie walk through six stories (AWS Bedrock AgentCore remote Claude Code sessions, Cursor multiplayer Projects, Van Duc Nguyen's agent-fleet gates, Google's Agent Distraction study, GitHub Agentic Workflows GA, and CNCF on platform engineering) through the lens of a self-improving, idea-to-deploy software factory, then a deep dive on the autonomous CI/CD stack with examples from StrongDM, Vercel, Chipp and AWS ABCA.
sources: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls (AWS)
Running a Coding Agent Fleet, Part 1: The Day the Agents Built Their Own Gates (Van Duc Nguyen)

Platform engineering needs to become more human…and less (CNCF)
